_comment.source: GitHub's REST API for Copilot seats: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/copilot/copilot-user-management (GET /orgs/{org}/copilot/billing/seats, POST and DELETE /orgs/{org}/copilot/billing/selected_users with a selected_usernames body).
_comment.credential: A token of an organization owner, sent as a bearer token: a classic token with the manage_billing:copilot scope (or admin:org), or a fine-grained token for this organization with the Copilot Business organization permission (read and write).
_comment.identity: Seats are assigned to GitHub usernames, matched from the same Google custom attribute as the GitHub Doorkey. Only members of the organization can get a seat, so pair it with the GitHub app (or invite people to the organization another way).
_comment.seats: Having a seat is having access. A leaver's seat is cancelled: GitHub marks it pending cancellation and they keep Copilot until the end of the billing cycle, and pending seats are not listed as access. Seats that come from a team are GitHub's to manage through that team and are left alone.
_comment.requirements: Copilot Business or Enterprise must be on, with access set to selected users; GitHub refuses seat changes with 422 when access is for all members or unconfigured.
